Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Halan Nethek: 38-year-old woman, 172 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: long narrow face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; one mismatched earring; one asymmetric ear cuff. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
